what: Plan documents env-var fallback and SIMPLE clamping that the current launcher does not enforce
scenario_or_breakage: With LARCH_DESIGN_ROUND_CAP=abc, Step 3 passes abc directly and plan-review-loop exits 2 instead of falling back. With LARCH_DESIGN_ROUND_CAP=5 on SIMPLE, the inner loop can still run up to 5 rounds; the Step 3 counter only gates later Step 3 entries.
